141:
SELECT sname 
FROM satscores 
WHERE virtual = 'F' AND avgscrread > ( SELECT AVG(avgscrread) FROM satscores WHERE virtual = 'F' GROUP BY county ORDER BY AVG(avgscrread) DESC LIMIT 1 ) 
GROUP BY sname, county 
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5	----- bird -----	california_schools

FROM schools s JOIN satscores sc ON s.cdscode = sc.cds
